title: Relational exit-token transport event model zero-training readiness
purpose: Qualify the causal, permutation-invariant, refusal-aware model interface on the complete C01-C08 cache before any optimization.

approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C01-C08 model readiness; zero C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 three-seed raw exit-token cache.
Sealed C01-C08 final unified learned observation features.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Audit all 188126 past-only reference rows. Execute forward/backward only on a deterministic eight-row real-cache batch containing corridor, junction and terminal targets.

teacher.source: Corrected causal junction/terminal episode arrays, used only to form the readiness loss batch.
teacher.valid_mask: Sealed past-only history_mask; left padding is replaced safely then masked before temporal aggregation.
teacher.student_input: Raw frozen exit tokens and learned geometry context only; event/episode/identity are loss/evaluation-only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph output. Future nodes may be provisional; edges remain execution-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies the eight-row real readiness batch and previously frozen token normalization.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; random initialization and no optimizer.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only sealed C01-C08 caches and the preceding feasibility seal are read.

methods.main: Shared token encoder plus explicit adjacent-frame 6x6 descriptor/heading/width/profile affinity, soft token transport, permutation-invariant learned event queries, seed mean/std fusion and a five-frame causal GRU. Outputs corridor/junction/terminal probabilities, commit probability, provisional probability and uncertainty.
methods.baseline: Old ActionSetNodeDetector, which pooled each frame before temporal aggregation.
methods.fallback: Any interface, permutation, causality, determinism, transport, finite-backward or refusal failure stops before training.

acceptance.population: Exactly 188126 C01-C08 observations, 142184/45942 split and five past-only same-traversal references.
acceptance.interface: Exactly 240101 trainable parameters; [B,5,3,6,40] tokens plus [B,5,3,8] geometry and bool history mask; typed event/commit/provisional/uncertainty/transport outputs.
acceptance.equivariance: Independent token permutations and seed permutation change event/commit probabilities by at most 1e-6; changed left padding has exactly zero effect; repeat is bit exact.
acceptance.numerics: Transport normalization error <=1e-6 and nontrivial; real-cache event MIL backward and all gradients finite.
acceptance.system: Zero optimizer/trained inference/threshold selection/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE and complete seal.

failure_policy: Any mismatch fails closed; do not train, alter tolerance or fall back to old pooling.
retention: Retain readiness JSON/CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, log, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full causal-reference audit plus one eight-row forward/backward
